name: @canetoad/grauss-kruger
description: Typed Gauss–Krüger (Transverse Mercator) forward/inverse projection utilities w/ MGA2020
author: Lewi <lewis@canetoad.ai>

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && node scripts/create-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run compile:test && npm run test:smoke
scripts.compile:test: mkdir -p dist/test && npx tsc test/gauss-kruger.test.ts --outDir dist --target ES2020 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop true
scripts.test:watch: npm run build && npm run compile:test && node --test --watch dist/gauss-kruger.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run lint
scripts.preversion: npm run test && npm run lint
